mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to tighter monetary policy or if S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% does not lead to wage inflation or if S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases do not correlate with positive S&P 500 forward returns or if the correlation coefficient is below 0.2 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in the supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases do not lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns or if the correlation coefficient is above -0.2 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% year-over-year, it signals a disinflationary environment with potential monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the specified conditions do not lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns or if the correlation coefficient is below 0.2 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the specified conditions do not lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns or if the correlation coefficient is below 0.2 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals strong demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases do not correlate with positive S&P 500 forward returns or if the correlation coefficient is below 0.2 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in Gross Domestic Product (GDPC1) signals an accommodative monetary policy supporting economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the specified conditions do not lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns or if the correlation coefficient is below 0.2 over any 3-year rolling window.
